newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesians charged with assault after riot-paper.
newsitem.headline: Indonesians charged with assault after riot-paper.

text.p: Eleven Indonesians have been charged with assault and destruction of property following a riot in a central Jakarta shopping district, the Media Indonesia newspaper reported on Wednesday.

Colonel Paimin Aboemar, chief of Jakarta police investigation department, was quoted as saying on Tuesday 11 people had been charged in court and faced up to five years in jail. He did not say when they were charged.
A police spokesman was not immediately available for comment.

Street vendors at the Tanah Abang market area set fire to the district office and a car and overturned several vehicles after local officials ordered them to remove their stalls that were blocking traffic, witnesses said.
At least 10 people were arrested following a gang war in mid-January in the same area, a centre for the textile trade.
